card.title: Show the projected reservoir state as topography
card.body: Reservoir Scope 0.10.0 adds signed peaks and valleys, fixed contour levels, a bright zero boundary and adjustable display height in both Essentials views. The original Surface presentation remains available. Geometry, color and contours derive from the same projected state field; this is not a network wiring or attractor-topology claim. Math, GPU, legacy pixel and native hosting checks pass. Live beings and numerical runtime are unchanged. Follow-up 0.10.1 halves the zero-contour blend strength; all 43 renderer checks pass again. A separate action/comparison ladder is proposed, not implemented.
card.source: Mike's September 9 invitation to improve the Essentials state projection

log.title: Add a topographic state projection
log.body: Implemented a reversible presentation choice and verified the focal recorded state against the original screenshot. Numerical input/state records and baseline views retain their earlier behavior. Board publication remains pending.

followup_log.title: Soften seams and specify a comparison ladder
followup_log.body: Built and opened Reservoir Scope 0.10.1 build 14 with softer zero contours. Preserved and reopened the completed Stage 1 run. Proposed separate additions for journal output, semantic return, journal memory, action choice and regulation, with matched comparisons. No journal action or comparison implementation is claimed; board publication remains pending.
